name: World Boxing Champion VR
summary:
Step into the ring and experience the excitement of World Boxing Champion VR, an immersive virtual reality boxing experience designed for players who love intense fights and competitive action.

In World Boxing Champion VR, train your boxing skills, improve your punches, and challenge different opponents as you work your way toward becoming a champion.

World Boxing Champion VR puts you directly inside the boxing arena, where timing, movement, and accurate punches are the keys to victory.
